  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION

Monday, June 22, 2020  6:00 PM  Teleconference

Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20, Park and Activities Commission Members will be
participating via teleconference.

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone, Meeting ID:
858 6140 0533, Meeting Password: 070197. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call-in
option from a phone line.)

- Public correspondence may be emailed to the Cynthia Morquecho, Community Services Supervisor at
cynthiam@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails received before 5:00 p.m. the night of the meeting will be forwarded
to the Committee for their consideration and included as part of the record.

- Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos”
page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an
“eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp
page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen
by the public, will be considered by the Committee and become part of the record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store), by
entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 858 6140 0533, Meeting Password: 070197. Members of the public
who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following process: After
joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the lower portion of your
screen. The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you would like to speak
on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each agenda item are available on the City's
website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city

MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION SPECIAL MEETING
  JUNE 22, 2020

  A special meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was
  called to order at 6:04 p.m. in Zoom format by CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR PERSICHINA led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Persichina,  Pope,  Bain,  Romanelli,  Ciarolla,
  McCormick

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Retz

  STAFF PRESENT:  Alexa Davis, Assistant to City Manager
  Jeannie Naughton, Planning Manager
  Michael Goldsmith, Maintenance Superintendent
  Cynthia Morquecho, Comm. Services Supervisor
  Daniel A-Haja, Community Services Coordinator

  4.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  MERRILL GARDENS (627 SILVER SPUR ROAD) RIGHT-OF-WAY LANDSCAPE
  IMPROVEMENTS

  PLANNING MANAGER JEANNIE NAUGHTON provided a brief overview of the staff
  report.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked what trees were already on the Drybank Drive side.
  PLANNING MANAGER NAUGHTON stated there was no designated landscape plan for
  the Commercial District, but pine and plum trees can be seen along the Silver Spur
  median. SUPERINTENDENT GOLDSMITH noted some evergreen pear trees and crepe
  myrtles are nice choices that are slow growing. He recommends the smaller grow box for
  them. COMMISSIONER BAIN suggested some consistency on the block.

  PROJECT MANAGER of SRM Construction stated that the distance from the curb to the
  building along Drybank Drive is narrower than the distance from the curb to the face of the
  building so the 15-gallon containers may not work as staff recommended.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN stated that trees in smaller containers may grow faster than in
  larger ones. SUERINTENDENT GOLDSMITH would like to look at the site to see if there
  is room for growth before making a recommendation.

  CHAIR PERSICHINA asked if the Commission was satisfied with the plans in general
  excluding the size of the trees. COMMISSIONER BAIN noted the plans called for 13 trees

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  1
JUNE 22, 2020
   in the drawing but 12 are requested. The recommendation calls for 8 trees along Silver
  Spur Road and 4 trees along Drybank. The drawing shows 13 trees along Silver
  Spur Road which shows a change in plans. PLANNING MANAGER NAUGHTON
  stated that renderings may not be shown to scale. She added that the trees will still add
  aesthetics to the area along Silver Spur Road and clarified that part of the area on Silver
  Spur Road where trees were initially shown on the rendering is actually a bus stop. She
  added that other types of ground cover will be there to add to the visual interest
  to the right-of-way landscaping which was not depicted in the rendering.
  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked where the trees will be laid out in the current plan.
  PLANNING MANAGER NAUGHTON provided additional explanation as to where trees
  would be located.

  VICE CHAIR POPE asked if the trees planted in Merrill Gardens are the same as
  those used in other parts of the district. ACM DAVIS noted that in the long run, a the
  Commercial District landscape guide may be helpful to develop and could brought back
  to the Commission.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that he is personally agrees with the tree
  types selected by the project manager. He noted the Fichus trees on Silver Spur
  Road and Hawthorne Blvd are cracking the pavement and overgrown and extending to
  the street. He asked if the trees suggested would pose the same results.
  SUPERINTENDENT GOLDSMITH noted the choices of trees were good for the area.

  VICE CHAIR POPE made a motion, seconded by CHAIR ROMANELLI to:

  ACCEPT STAFF RECOMMENDATION.

  CHAIR RETZ REQUESTED A ROLL CALL VOTE:

  AYES: Ciarolla, Pope, Romanelli, Persichina, Bain, McCormick

  NOES: None

  ABSENT : Retz

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  CHAIR PERSICHINA noted to add the Commercial District Tree List to the future agenda
  items.

  5.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR PERSICHINA made a motion, seconded by COMMISISONER RETZ to,

  ADJOURN THE MEETING AT 7:44 PM TO THE NEXT ADJOURNED PARK AND
  ACTIVITIES MEETING ON JULY 20, 2020 AT 6:00 P.M., WHICH WILL MEET
  AT ERNIE HOWLETT PARK, 25851 HAWTHORNE BLVD., ROLLING HILLS
  ESTATES.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

JUNE 22, 2020
   Respectfully submitted,  Approved,
